무엇을: 24X National Exchange가 SEC 승인을 받음(등록 승인, 주 5일 23시간 거래 포함), 2024-11-28 발표
원문 근거 문장: 24 Exchange announced today that it has received approval from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to operate 24X National Exchange as the first national securities exchange in the U.S. that allows trading of U.S. securities 23 hours each workday.

무엇을: 24X 개시: 2025-10-15 평일 오전 4시~오후 8시(ET)만 시작. 야간 세션은 아직
원문 근거 문장: trading has officially commenced on 24X National Exchange (the "Exchange"), the first national securities exchange approved by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to offer 23-hour weekday trading of U.S. equities under full regulatory oversight. 24X National Exchange offers live trading of U.S. equities from 4:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET on weekdays

무엇을: 24X는 MEMX Technologies 기술 위에서 운영(MEMX는 Blue Ocean ATS의 기술 파트너이기도 함)
원문 근거 문장: 24X National Exchange is built upon a proven, cutting-edge technology platform powered by MEMX Technologies, ensuring a seamless, resilient, and cost-effective trading experience.

무엇을: SEC가 24X에 임시 조건부 면제를 줌. 2027-01-24부터, 통합시세(SIP)가 2026-12-06까지 준비되지 못할 때만 야간 세션(밤 9시~새벽 4시, 일~목 밤) 거래 허용
원문 근거 문장: starting on January 24, 2027, the Commission is granting this temporary conditional exemptive relief that would allow 24X to offer trading during the 24X Market Session but only in the event that the Equity Data Plans are unable to meet the December 6, 2026 implementation date

무엇을: SEC가 통합시세(SIP)를 운영하는 3개 플랜의 시간 연장을 승인하고 2026-12-06부터 시행하도록 명시
원문 근거 문장: the Commission stated that the Participants must comply and enforce compliance with the Plans as amended starting on December 6, 2026.

무엇을: UTP 플랜 55차 개정 승인(2026-06-26): SIP 운영 시간을 일요일 밤 9시~금요일 밤 8시(ET)로 연장, 월~목 밤 8시에 1시간 정지
원문 근거 문장: extend the Processor's hours of operations to receive and disseminate Quotation Information, Transaction Reports, and related information in Eligible Securities from 9:00 p.m. Eastern Time (``ET'') Sunday to 8:00 p.m. ET Friday; provided however, that the Processor will pause operations at 8:00 p.m. ET on Monday through Thursday for one hour

무엇을: Nasdaq가 UTP SIP 연장 시간표가 2026-12-06부터 적용된다고 공지
원문 근거 문장: The updated UTP SIP transmission schedule supporting Extended Trading Hours will take effect on December 6, 2026.

무엇을: SEC가 NSCC의 연장 거래시간 지원 규칙을 2026-05-27 승인(야간 체결분 청산 준비)
원문 근거 문장: on May 27, 2026, the Commission approved rules for the National Securities Clearing Corporation (``NSCC'') to support extended trading hours for the U.S. equity markets.

무엇을: Nasdaq가 2025-12-29 주 5일 23시간 거래 규칙 변경 제출, 2026-01-13 연방관보에 의견 공고(SR-NASDAQ-2025-109)
원문 근거 문장: On December 29, 2025, The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (``Nasdaq'' or ``Exchange'') filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (``SEC'' or ``Commission''), pursuant to Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (``Act'') and Rule 19b-4 thereunder, a proposed rule change to extend the Nasdaq trading hours for NMS stocks to 23 hours a day, five days a week.

무엇을: SEC가 Nasdaq 23시간 거래를 2026-04-10 신속 승인(91 FR 20222). 승인일에는 시작일이 정해지지 않음
원문 근거 문장: Notice of Filing of Amendment Nos. 2 and 3 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Rule Change, as Amended by Amendment Nos. 2 and 3, To Extend the Exchange's Trading Hours to 23 Hours a Day, Five Days a Week April 10, 2026.

무엇을: Nasdaq 야간 세션은 SIP가 야간에 운영될 수 있을 때 시작한다고 규칙에 적음
원문 근거 문장: Nasdaq proposes to launch the operation of its 23/5 market upon the availability of the Securities Information Processor (``SIP'') to operate during the Night Session.

무엇을: NYSE Arca 22시간 거래(월~목 01:30~23:30 ET)를 SEC가 2025-02-11 승인(SR-NYSEARCA-2024-89, Release 34-102400)
원문 근거 문장: On February 11, 2025, the Securities and Exchange Commission (``Commission'') approved the Exchange's proposal to adopt temporary Rule 7.34-E(T) to lengthen its trading hours for NMS stocks to 1:30 a.m. Eastern Time through 11:30 p.m. Eastern Time on Monday through Thursday

무엇을: NYSE Arca가 2026-05-12 야간 세션 추가 규칙(SR-NYSEARCA-2026-53)을 제출, 제출 즉시 효력(별도 승인 명령 아님). 시작은 업계 준비일 2026-12-06에 맞춘다고 밝힘
원문 근거 문장: Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Temporary Rule 7.34-E(T) To Provide for an Overnight Trading Session

무엇을: 로펌 정리: SEC가 24X, Cboe EDGX, MEMX, Nasdaq, NYSE Arca 5곳의 23x5 거래를 조건부 승인했으나 거래소 연장 거래는 아직 시작 전, 시작 예정일 2026-12-06
원문 근거 문장: To date, the SEC has provided conditional approval for five national securities exchanges —24X, Cboe EDGX, MEMX, Nasdaq, and NYSE Arca —to provide 23x5 trading, allowing market participants to trade equities 23 hours a day, five days a week

사업 법인: Blue Ocean ATS, Bruce ATS, IBKR Eos ATS, MOON ATS
무엇을: 야간 거래 ATS는 4곳(Blue Ocean, Bruce, IBKR Eos, MOON). SEC 직원 분석상 야간 거래량은 평균 NMS 주식 거래량의 약 0.9%, 전년 대비 359% 증가
무엇을 잰 것: 야간 세션 거래량이 NMS 주식 거래량(주식 수)에서 차지하는 비중, 평균 거래일
원문 근거 문장: Four alternative trading systems—Blue Ocean ATS, Bruce ATS, IBKR Eos ATS and MOON ATS—currently trade in the overnight hours. An analysis by SEC staff regarding overnight trading found that the current trading volume in the overnight session is small (approximately 0.9% of total NMS share volume on an average trade date) but growing quickly (359% year-over-year).

무엇을: Blue Ocean이 MEMX를 기술 파트너로 선정, MEMX의 market-as-a-service 체결 시스템으로 Blue Ocean ATS 운영(2024-01-25 발표)
원문 근거 문장: MEMX will provide BOT its sophisticated market-as-a-service trading system to operate the Blue Ocean ATS global trading platform.

무엇을: Interactive Brokers가 Blue Ocean ATS에 연결해 자체 IBEOS ATS 외 야간 유동성을 보강(2023-07-25 회사 발표)
원문 근거 문장: Overnight Trading liquidity provided by Interactive Brokers' own IBEOS Alternative Trading System (ATS), Interactive Brokers is now connected to the Blue Ocean ATS.

무엇을: Robinhood 24 Hour Market의 야간 주문이 Blue Ocean ATS(BOATS)로 가는 것으로 2023-05 보도(Robinhood 직접 문서는 이번에 열지 못함)
원문 근거 문장: Robinhood overnight trades will route to Blue Ocean ATS To make the 24 Hour Market a reality, Robinhood partnered with Blue Ocean ATS, LLC, a US broker dealer which operates the alternative trading system BOATS.

무엇을: 회사 연표: 2023년 Blue Ocean ATS가 Robinhood, Interactive Brokers와 연결 확대(회사 주장). 2018년 TD Ameritrade가 Blue Ocean Session 고객으로 소개됨
원문 근거 문장: 2023 Expansion Global Expansion Tokyo Stock Exchange Makes 5% Strategic Investment in Blue Ocean Technologies and Partners with Blue Ocean ATS to Expand Trading Access in Japan. Blue Ocean ATS expands its connectivity to brokers Robinhood and Interactive Brokers.

무엇을: 회사 연표: 2021 캐나다 Urbana Corporation이 주도 투자자가 되고, 이후 Urbana 등과 2차 투자 유치. 2021-06 BOATS 개시
원문 근거 문장: Canadian firm Urbana Corporation becomes lead investor in Blue Ocean Technologies, to support the trading of U.S. listed equities after hours.

무엇을: Blue Ocean ATS가 거래하는 NMS 증권은 약 11,000 종목(회사 홈페이지)
무엇을 잰 것: Blue Ocean ATS 거래 가능 NMS 증권 수(회사 표기)
원문 근거 문장: Blue Ocean ATS is currently trading all National Market System securities, which includes approximately 11,000 symbols.

무엇을: 2024-11 업계 행사 보도: Blue Ocean 플랫폼 브로커 55곳(일본, 한국, 싱가포르, 미국). CEO는 NYSE의 22시간 제안으로 경쟁이 자사에 유리했다고 말함
무엇을 잰 것: Blue Ocean 플랫폼의 브로커 수(CEO 발언 보도)
원문 근거 문장: The firm has 55 brokers on the platform covering Japan, South Korea, Singapore, and the U.S.

무엇을: CEO Hyndman: 거래소의 연장 거래 진출에 대해 "경쟁은 우리에게 좋았다", NYSE 발표가 전 세계에 반향을 일으켜 문의가 크게 늘었다(2024-11 SIFMA 행사)
틀 항목: 야간 시장이 거래소 23시간 거래로 받는 영향 > 회사 발표
원문 근거 문장: Competition has been good for us,” said Brian Hyndman, CEO of Blue Ocean Technologies LLC, at the SIFMA Market Structure conference on a panel about ATS innovation. “The NYSE announcement has resonated around the globe.

무엇을: tZERO Securities, LLC는 SEC 등록 브로커딜러, FINRA와 SIPC 회원이며 tZERO Securities ATS 운영자(회사 서술)
틀 항목: 기업 개요 > 취득 라이선스 및 근거 법령 > 미국
원문 근거 문장: tZERO Securities, LLC is a broker-dealer registered with the SEC and a member of FINRA and SIPC . It is the operator of the tZERO Securities ATS.

무엇을: SEC의 24X 승인 명령일은 2024-11-27(89 FR 97092), 야간 거래는 SIP 준비 공표 전에는 시작 불가, 18개월 안에 준비 안 되면 야간 규칙 승인 무효(Nasdaq 명령 각주 인용)
원문 근거 문장: Securities Exchange Act. Release No. 89-235 [sic] (Nov. 27, 2024); 89 FR 97092 (order approving application of 24X National Exchange, LLC for registration as a national securities exchange and to trade 23 hours per day, 5 days per week)
